scope: Proposition 7.2 (Fixed-base deformation) of the manuscript “Projective-space bases of Lagrangian fibrations” (preprints/Projective-Space-Bases-of-Lagrangian-Fibrations-September-23-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 041 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5fdf543649f1469a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 56. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: After shrinking D, there is a proper holomorphic map f : X −→ B × D over D whose central fiber is f0. Every ft : Xt → B has connected fibers, and every irreducible component of every fiber is an n-dimensional Lagrangian subvariety. Under the chosen marking, c1(f∗ t H) = e for every t. For some m > 0, the extension of f∗ 0 Hm is relatively generated and defines these fibrations after Stein factorization.
